g.text: O’Neill Cylinder seasonal lighting · Los Angeles latitude (34.0522° N)
Declination ±23.44°; daylight and noon-light curves use solar geometry, not pure sine waves. One Earth daylight hour maps to 0.5 simulated minutes. Twilights are 1 minute each. Moon
minima repeat every 6 hours (12 times per year).
